title: Live's Next song line: a tied final time, and songs with zero or one action
acceptance: When a song's last time holds two actions (a cue and a move at the same anchor), 'Next song: <title>' shows while they are next, not only after they fire: nextSongTitle in apps/web/src/components/LiveMode.tsx counts actions ahead by anchor time, not by event index.

On a song with no cues or moves, or with one, the line does not show from the song's first second as if the song were ending; the owner chooses the rule (for example, only in the song's last part, or only once an action has passed), and the tests that assert today's behaviour change with it.
nextAction: Agent-created (Neo, 2026-11-23) at the close of round 1123 from #789's final review, notes 1 and 2 (neither significant). Backlog until the owner sets Ready. Owner-gated path (LiveMode.tsx). iOS RF-1240 should follow whatever rule this lands.

evidence.summary: #789's fresh-context final review at d6fdfda: no significant findings. Note 1: with cue@0, cue@60000 and move@60000, lastAtOrBefore takes the last of the equal run, so the count goes from 2 to 0 and the line first shows at 1:00. Note 2: a song with no actions counts 0 ahead, so the line shows for the whole song (a unit test asserts it).
